title: DeviceIdentityVerification
description: Cryptographic and logical attestation verification record for a physical hardware device identity.

deviceId.description: Canonical immutable logical UUID of the device

serialNumber.description: Physical serial number stamped on device hardware

productVariantId.description: Reference to product catalog variant identifier

firmwareFamily.description: Target firmware binary track for OTA updates

secureElementPresent.description: Whether hardware contains an ATECC/OPTIGA or ESP32 secure eFuse/eCDSA vault

attestationType.description: Cryptographic method used to verify device identity

attestationVerified.description: True if cryptographic proof matched expected signature/HMAC

verifiedAt.description: Timestamp when identity attestation was executed
